summary: Built the whole change: users table (first migration in the repo), idempotent seed script, POST /auth/login + /auth/logout + GET /auth/me with the session in an httpOnly clv_at cookie, and the /login screen plus route-guard middleware. Verified against the approved mockup in a real browser at 390/700/1180px, fixing three genuine drifts (card max-width and input font-size lost to Tailwind's breakpoint emission order; radius resolved to the theme scale rather than the mockup's 12px). Backend code could not be committed: backend/ is a nested git repository.

title: collapsible sidebar shell, mobile drawer, sample dashboard
summary: Built the (app) route group with an auth guard, a floating collapsible sidebar (264/72, cookie-persisted, Cmd+B), a mobile Sheet drawer, a footer user block replacing user-chip.tsx, and a sample dashboard replacing the Next.js scaffold; eight shadcn primitives were hand-copied since the CLI hangs here. One real defect was found and fixed during verify: the sidebar cookie constant lived in a "use client" module, so the server layout received a client-reference proxy and the collapse state never survived a reload.

title: toast notifications and confirm dialogs as reusable frontend scaffold
summary: Built the whole feedback layer: sonner Toaster wrapped to the --popover surface with five inline knockout tone icons, a single imperative ConfirmProvider owning its pending state, and a MutationCache.onError reporting every failed mutation once unless the call site overrides it. Browser verify against the approved mockups found five visual mismatches (two dropped multi-layer shadows, a collapsed toast stack, a mis-positioned close button, and desktop padding at mobile); all five were fixed and re-measured clean, with baselines committed under verify/baseline/.

title: file service + files table, local disk storage behind authenticated upload/download
summary: Built the files table (relative storage_key, int size_bytes, FK to users ON DELETE RESTRICT) plus FilesService/FilesController behind JwtAuthGuard, with a required FILE_STORAGE_PATH env var, a mime allowlist excluding SVG, a 100MB cap via multer diskStorage, and streamed downloads carrying nosniff. All 7 sections verified against the running API: 51 backend tests pass, the migration applies and reverts clean, and every status and code in spec.md was measured live. Two deviations: an extra form field was being ignored rather than rejected (fixed with an empty body DTO so the global ValidationPipe returns 400), and spec.md's claim that original_name is stored verbatim is false - multer basenames the filename before the app sees it, so that clause needs amending (blocker logged; every security property still holds).
